newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Light's CITIC Pac placing approved.
newsitem.headline: China Light's CITIC Pac placing approved.

text.p: China Light & Power Co Ltd (CLP) said on Wednesday its shareholders had agreed to allot and issue 298.60 million new shares to CITIC Pacific Ltd to satisfy the second tranche of a January placement.
"The resolution was passed at CLP's Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) in the afternoon," it said in a statement.

Together with Tranche One comprising 199.07 million new shares allotted and issued under the directors' general mandate on February 10, CLP will have issued 497.66 million new shares to CITIC Pacific at HK$32.66 per share, the company said.
After the completion of the placement announced on January 28, CITIC Pacific will hold a 20 percent interest in the enlarged share capital of CLP, the electricity supplier said.
CITIC Pacific's managing director Henry Fan and deputy managing Vernon Moore would be appointed to the CLP board upon approval for completion of Tranche Two, it said.
